subject: Hosted API volume & SLA clarifications — tokens/month and peak TPS
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@stampede.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-25T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API — follow-up: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great to see how Stampede plans to embed summarization and retrieval into your agent flows. As discussed, we need a few numbers to put together accurate hosted pricing and an SLA playbook for your SREs. Please confirm the items below so we can draft a pricing scenario and a mutual action plan: 

- Expected monthly token volume (range is fine, e.g., 50M–200M)
- Typical tokens per request (prompt + completion split if possible)
- Peak TPS (per-second sustained peak you expect at launch week)
- Concurrency profile (95th percentile concurrent requests)
- % of requests that need streaming vs non-streaming responses
- Target unit economics (target $ per 1M tokens) and monthly budget band
- Any hard procurement timelines or compliance blockers (SOC 2, data residency)

I've attached the traffic worksheet you can use to drop numbers into (stampede_poc_traffic_profile.csv). If easier, reply with ballpark figures and we'll iterate.

Next steps on our side once we have numbers:
- Build two hosted pricing scenarios (conservative + aggressive) with token-based and TPS-backed SLOs
- Identify whether Dedicated is worth evaluating based on peak TPS and budget
- Share an initial Mutual Action Plan and a draft SLA appendix for review

Would you be able to send numbers by EOD tomorrow? If not, we can take a ten-minute follow-up tomorrow to capture them.

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0198

[attachment: stampede_poc_traffic_profile.csv (csv)]

From: Elena Morris <elena@stampede.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@stampede.ai>, procurement@stampede.ai
Date: 2028-08-25T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API — follow-up: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS

Hi Jasmine — thanks for the clear list. See our initial numbers below (we're still validating with engineering but these are what we used for our budget ask):

- Expected monthly tokens: 120M–180M (we model a 6-month ramp to steady-state ~150M)
- Typical tokens per request: ~650 tokens (avg). Prompt/completion split ~35/65
- Peak TPS (sustained for short bursts): 130 TPS (we plan a 5–10 minute backfill burst window)
- 95th percentile concurrency: ~420 concurrent requests
- Streaming: ~18% of requests need streaming (real-time partial responses)
- Target unit economics: ideally $12 / 1M tokens (current procurement target)
- Monthly budget band: planning for $1,500–$2,500 initially; can expand with clear SLOs
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II required, prefer US data residency

We're attaching the SOC2 checklist and our sample traffic export for your modelers. If you can sketch a hosted scenario that hits $12/1M at ~150M tokens with the ability to handle the 130 TPS peak (with graceful fallback), that would be super helpful for procurement.

Procurement timeline: procurement expects an approved vendor list by Sep 15; legal will want a draft SOW and data processing addendum within two weeks after that.

Cheers,

Elena Morris
Head of Platform Engineering | Stampede AI
elena@stampede.ai | +1 (617) 555-2304

[attachment: Stampede_SOC2_Request.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@stampede.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-26T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API — follow-up: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS

Thanks Elena — this is perfect and very actionable. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

- Numbers received: we'll model two hosted scenarios (A: conservative capacity with autoscaling; B: higher-availability with reserved warm capacity). Both will show token economics at your $12 / 1M target and will surface the tradeoffs on peak TPS and tail latency.
- Streaming: we'll size the streaming path separately and include a cost delta for the ~18% requests.
- Fallbacks: propose an automated fallback to a lower-cost model variant during prolonged sustained bursts to protect costs; we'll show SLO impact in the doc.
- Compliance: our Private deployment option can meet US data residency; SOC 2 artifacts shared via secure link (we'll upload the report to the Drive folder listed below).

Immediate next steps: 
1) We'll drop the two hosted pricing scenarios and an SLA appendix into the HubSpot deal record by EOD Monday (Aug 28).
2) Schedule a 30-min pricing review with engineering + procurement present — are you available Wed Aug 30 or Thu Aug 31?
3) I'll include Connor to run a quick capacity check against our Dedicated thresholds based on the 130 TPS peak you called out.

If that timeline works I'll proceed and share the MP (mutual plan) + draft SOW for legal to review.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0198
